answer: Agents booking a comet observation trip from a jetty to a ridge can require sellers to bond each exclusive reservation. Every signed promise names the same registered vehicle, time slot and bond ID. Two incompatible promises provide public evidence that automatically forfeits the bond; alias keys must reference the vehicle's registered bond rather than invent fresh capacity. Set the bond above the maximum receipts obtainable before conflict checks run. This deters double-booking through Sybils, assuming reliable vehicle registration, complete promise logging and enforceable forfeiture.
